question: At the latest finalized Ethereum mainnet block when requested, what address does getPair(0x6b175474e89094c44da98b954eedeac495271d0f,0xc02aaa39b223fe8d0a0e5c4f27ead9083c756cc2) return on Uniswap V2 factory 0x5c69bee701ef814a2b6a3edd4b1652cb9cc5aa6f?

definitions.window: The observation covers the last 1 hours ending at the latest finalized block available when requested. Resolve this once to inclusive fromBlock and toBlock; state reads use toBlock.
definitions.missing: If any required data is unavailable, inconsistent or incomplete, report inability; do not encode unknown as zero, false or an empty list.
definitions.call: Call getPair(address,address) returning address at toBlock with the two addresses in the question in that order. Zero means no pair exists.
